sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

It is always a pleasure to work with your esteemed house, continuing the strong tradition of craftsmanship and trust between our companies. For this agreement, our offer stands at a price of €52.90 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. 

To remain transparent about our situation, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. We take great pride in the dedication of our foundry workforce and the quality we deliver to our partners every day.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our successful cooperation together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.subject: PH-100 price adjustment – counterproposal and cost breakdown request
move.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

Thank you for your offer and for twelve years of reliable cooperation.

You cite WAGES-METAL at +3.1 % on a 28 % cost share. That works out to roughly +0.9 % on the unit price, well below the +8.8 % requested.

Could you share a cost breakdown for PH-100, particularly the energy share and its development? That would help us find a price that keeps your foundry healthy.

We can offer planning security in return: a 24-month contract covering our full volume. Please find two alternative packages attached.

We look forward to your feedback.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We value our twelve-year partnership and welcome your offer of a 24-month contract, which grants us both planning security. Building on your second proposal with a 24-month term and 45-day payment period, we can offer a revised price of €51.60.

Our current Angebot stands at a price of €51.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 January 2027. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

My colleagues will provide the requested cost breakdown, including the energy share, to ensure full transparency. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. Our costs move with SCRAP-E3, WAGES-METAL, GAS-TTF; the figures stay with us.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.subject: PH-100: revised packages for a 24-month agreement
move.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

Thank you for moving to EUR 51.60 and for agreeing to share the cost breakdown.

You state that WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % and makes up 28 % of your cost. That accounts for about 0.9 % of the price. The current EUR 51.60 is still 6.2 % above today's EUR 48.60.

We would like to understand how much of the remaining gap comes from energy and from scrap. Could your colleagues send the breakdown with those shares and their development since last year?

In the meantime, we have attached two revised packages. Both are based on a 24-month term covering our full volume of 4,000 housings a year.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

Many thanks for your message; I have read it carefully together with my people here at the foundry, and we have given it the attention it deserves.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €51.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 January 2027.
A few words from the foundry on this.
My colleagues are finalizing the cost breakdown for energy and scrap and will provide it to you shortly.
In recognition of our long-standing partnership and your movement, we are pleased to offer a further concession to €51.10 for the 24-month agreement with 45 days payment.
Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net.

We have worked together for many years, and I am confident that we will find a fair way forward, as we always have between our two houses.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.subject: PH-100: accepting EUR 51.10, one question on timing
move.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

Thank you for your clear answer. We accept your price of EUR 51.10 per housing for 24 months and our full 4,000 housings a year.

We have one remaining request. The increase was announced at short notice for our own customer pricing. Could the new price apply from 1 February 2027 instead of 1 January, or alternatively with 60-day payment terms? Either option is attached at your price.

If neither is possible, please tell us. We would then still like to close on your current terms.

We look forward to receiving the energy and scrap breakdown.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
